description: Is this token safe to buy? Give a token contract address and a chain (base, arc, robinhood, solana or x1) and get a verdict: BASED, MID, COOKED or RADIOACTIVE, from a real simulated buy and full sell (Base, Robinhood Chain) or that chain's measured exit (Arc, Solana, X1), with the round-trip cost and a plain one-liner. Free, read-only, no account. It measures the exit right now; it is not advice and not a guarantee, and a read we could not make comes back as an error, never as clean.

chain.description: Which chain the token is on. Default base.

tokenAddress.description: The token contract address: 0x... for Base, Robinhood Chain or Arc; a base58 mint for Solana or X1.
